title: 第三章 玄功蛇影
content_zh:
等墨非夜等人赶到吴鹿城时，大局已定。

    所有的宋人都已放下武器，立下“景晖之誓”，等待景辉台派人来接收。

    虽然秦关万里道，从此远离故土，可活着，就还会有希望。

    传信的墨者，坚守了他的诺言，坦然赴死，自刎在左卿尸体旁。

    墨非夜等人一进吴鹿城境内，就被巡逻的士兵带到了大帐内。

    “哈哈。子迁！”墨攻行看到账内之人，着实大吃了一惊。

    没想到在这里竟然遇到了老朋友，曾经的墨者子迁。

    学派与门派不一样，大部分学派都十分松散式，就算以严格著称的墨家，除了一些学习特殊技能的核心弟子，其他人想离开就能离开。

    只要以后不使用墨家的名义，就没人会理会。

    所以有些士子，为了求询心中的答案，在求学于多个学派后，融合诸家学说，加上自己的领悟，从而形成新的学术思想。

    而门派却有很严格的纪律，叛师被视为大忌，对于判师者唯有不死不休。

    当年的墨者子迁，现在已是雨军的将领。

    子迁本是兵家，后因为得罪贵族，给他冠以好杀之名后，请墨家诛杀于他，在最后关头墨家发现事实并非如此，便将奄奄一息的子迁救回。

    子迁在墨家休养避难期间，被墨家“非攻兼爱”的学说感染，因而成为墨者，并且与墨非夜，墨攻行等墨者，一起多次执行任务。

    后又因为理念不合，离开墨家。

    看到墨非夜两人，一向严肃的子迁也不由得露出了笑容，捏着墨攻行的肥脸打趣道：“哈哈，攻行，你的身材越来越魁梧了。”

    看到两人熟识，墨非夜露出疑惑的眼神。

    子迁看到墨非夜对自己好像陌生人一般，也很疑惑地看向墨攻行。

    墨攻行连忙解释：“自从那件事回来后，就是这样，中间那几年的记忆好像出现了点问题，所以不认识你。”

    并马上对墨非夜说道：“这就是当时和我们一起去的子迁。”

    墨非夜看了看子迁，点了点头。

    “哦，我这里有巫医，要不要试一试？”子迁关切地问道。

    一阵急促的脚步声，在大帐外停了下来。

    “大帅，圣女在祖陵遇袭！”

    “你？？”墨攻行睁大眼睛望着子迁。

    子迁嘴角一撇，一副得意洋洋的样子，有些卖弄地说道：“哼哼，没错，本人就是位高权重的大帅卫起。”

    其实现场最吃惊的不是墨攻行，而是子迁的随身侍女，做梦也想不到，平时不苟言笑的大帅，还有这一面。

    墨非夜两人沿途看到，鹿吴城内井然有序，到处都巡逻的雨军，宋军则被分开关押，屠杀或者虐待的事件并未发生。

    祖陵外的广场，被雨军堵得严严实实。
content_en:
By the time Mo Feiye and others arrived at Wulucheng, the overall situation was decided.

    All the people of the Song Dynasty had put down their weapons, sworn the "Jinghui Oath", and waited for Jinghuitai to send someone to receive them.

    Although Qin Guan is thousands of miles away from home, there is still hope for those who are alive.

    The messenger of Mo kept his promise, went to death calmly, and committed suicide beside Zuo Qing's body.

    As soon as Mo Feiye and others entered Wulucheng, they were taken to the tent by patrolling soldiers.

    "Haha. Ziqian!" Mo Gengxing was really surprised when he saw the people in the tent.

    Unexpectedly, I met an old friend here, the former Mohist Ziqian.

    Schools are different from sects. Most schools are very loose. Even the Mohist school, which is famous for its strictness, except for some core disciples who learn special skills, others can leave if they want.

    As long as the name of the Mohist family is not used in the future, no one will care.

    Therefore, some scholars, in order to seek answers in their hearts, after studying in multiple schools of thought, integrated the theories of various schools and added their own understanding to form new academic thoughts.

    However, the sect has very strict disciplines, and betraying the master is considered a taboo, and those who judge the master will be punished until death.

    The Mo Zhe Ziqian back then was now the general of the Yu Army.

    Ziqian was originally a military strategist. Later, because he offended the nobles and gave him the reputation of being easy to kill, he asked the Mohist family to kill him. At the last moment, the Mohist family discovered that this was not the case and rescued the dying Ziqian.

    While recuperating and taking refuge in the Mohist family, Ziqian was infected by the Mohist theory of "love without attacking", so he became a Mohist and performed many missions with Mohists such as Mo Feiye and Mo Gongxing.

    Later, he left the Mohist family because of different ideas.

    Seeing Mo Feiye and the two of them, Zi Qian, who had always been serious, couldn't help but smile. He pinched Mo Gongxing's fat face and joked: "Haha, Gongxing, you are getting bigger and bigger."

    Seeing that the two of them were familiar with each other, Mo Feiye showed doubts in his eyes.

    Zi Qian saw that Mo Feiye was like a stranger to him, and looked at Mo Gongxing with confusion.

    Mo Gongxing quickly explained: "It's been like this since I came back from that incident. There seems to be some problems with my memory in the intervening years, so I don't recognize you."

    And immediately said to Mo Feiye: "This is Zi Qian who went with us at that time."

    Mo Feiye looked at Zi Qian and nodded.

    "Oh, I have a witch doctor here, do you want to give it a try?" Zi Qian asked with concern.

    A burst of rapid footsteps stopped outside the big tent.

    "Commander, the saint was attacked in the ancestral mausoleum!"

    "You??" Mo Jinxing looked at Zi Qian with wide eyes.

    Ziqian curled up his lips, looked triumphant, and said a little show off: "Humph, yes, I am the high-ranking commander Wei Qi."

    In fact, the most surprising person at the scene was not Mo Gongxing, but Zi Qian's maid. Never in his wildest dreams could he have imagined that the usually stern and unsmiling commander would have this side.

    Along the way, Mo Feiye and the two saw that Luwu City was in order, with Yu troops patrolling everywhere, while Song troops were detained separately, and no massacres or abuses occurred.

    The square outside the ancestral mausoleum was tightly blocked by the rain army.
